questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

 All breads are croissants.

All breads are muffins.

All breads are pastries.

Conclusions:

(I): All croissants are pastries.

(II): Some pastries are muffins.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All breads are croissants.**
All breads are muffins.

All breads are pastries.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f0f016767df5a70f172bd73faaa7ba7d1935015007f91457dac4e1277a6f1fc.png] 

Conclusions:

**(I) All croissants are pastries:**

From the statements:** We know all Breads are Croissants, and all Breads are Pastries.

Since the possibility exists that some Croissants are not Pastries

Conclusion (I) does not follow.

**(II) Some pastries are muffins:**

**From the statements:** We know that the set of **Breads** is completely contained within the set of **Pastries** AND completely contained within the set of **Muffins**.

Conclusion (II) logically follows.

So, **Only conclusion (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1, T, R, A and K are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2, S, O, M and E are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.

T sits third to the right of K. The one facing S is an immediate neighbour of K. The one facing R is an immediate neighbour of S. The one facing T is an immediate neighbour of O. M sits at some place to the left of E. Which of the following represents both people sitting at extreme ends of the rows?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1, T, R, A and K are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2, S, O, M and E are seated and all of them are facing north.

1) T sits third to the right of K.

2) The one facing S is an immediate neighbour of K.

3) The one facing R is an immediate neighbour of S.

4) The one facing T is an immediate neighbour of O.

5) M sits at some place to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0cfd07a868e31294e1872ea6fe4822e04acbf0edb3d355d512eec8a53c7f18f.png] 

And, A will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a303b0d830972c24f9f1d477cec4b62c24eb1ecb3e74a5922bd7b6f1275d335.png] 

So, **M and K **are people sitting at extreme ends of the rows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Which is the number on the face opposite to the face containing 10?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ac9a059bbed2c76f38f22197fcb3abdbec58ee38b53c9cdda333dcb4d77ded4.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: If two positions of a single die have two faces showing the same number, then the remaining faces that are not common must be **opposite** to each other.

Now, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89bbb99d5edf47a9731ad541fda1349b9cc997b6ca4cd9077fa0c8f930c3dcd3.png]

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

(98 – 45 + 14) + (84 ÷ 7) – 36 + (6 × 2) = 43

(Note: Interchange should be done of entire number and not individual digits of a given number)
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: (98 – 45 + 14) + (84 ÷ 7) – 36 + (6 × 2) = 43

Now,checking the given options, then:

Option 1) 7 and 14

⇒ (98−45+7)+(84÷14)−36+(6×2)

⇒ 60+6−36+12=42 ≠ 43 → Incorrect

Option 2) 2 and 7

⇒ (98−45+14)+(84÷2)−36+(6×7)

⇒ 67+42−36+42=115 ≠ 43 → Incorrect

**Option 3) 98 and 84**

**⇒ (84−45+14)+(98÷7)−36+(6×2)**

**⇒ 53+14−36+12=43 → Correct**

Option 4) 7 and 6

⇒ (98−45+14)+(84÷6)−36+(7×2)

⇒ 67+14−36+14=59 ≠ 43 → Incorrect

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
